home.introP1: Kalyce Consulting works with the heads of small businesses, SMEs and startups on what actually gets in the way: too little visibility online, disorganised prospecting, processes that eat up the days, an expansion plan with no numbers behind it.
home.introP2: Our conviction: advice that stops at the recommendation is worth nothing. We stay through implementation, and we offer monthly follow-up so the effects hold over time.
home.p1Text: No commission, nothing to sell you. Our only interest is that your transformation succeeds.
home.p2Text: Senior consultants, former executives and sector specialists. No pyramid, just substance.
home.p3Text: Clear contracts, rigorous scoping, and a presence beside your teams all the way to impact.
home.ctaText: A first 30-minute conversation, no commitment, to understand your context and qualify how we might help.

faqs.q1: What kinds of companies do you work with?
faqs.a1: We work with small and mid-sized companies as well as large groups, in both the private and public sectors. Our engagements are aimed above all at executive committees and leaders carrying a strategic or organisational transformation.
faqs.q2: How does a typical engagement unfold?
faqs.a2: Every engagement begins with a short assessment (two to four weeks) that pins down the issues precisely. We then build a roadmap together and steer implementation alongside your teams until the expected results are achieved.
faqs.q3: How long does an engagement usually last?
faqs.a3: Our engagements run from three to twelve months depending on complexity. An assessment can be completed in three weeks; a large-scale transformation spans six to eighteen months with quarterly milestones.
faqs.a4: Our proposals are based on a fixed fee or a capped time-and-materials arrangement, depending on the nature of the engagement. We favour transparency: precise scoping, deliverables and review arrangements agreed from the outset.
faqs.q5: Which sectors do you work in?
faqs.a5: Industry, B2B services, healthcare, the public sector, energy and retail. Our approach is cross-cutting: we rely on proven methods and bring in sector specialists as the issues require.
faqs.a6: All our engagements are governed by a strict confidentiality undertaking. We systematically sign an NDA before the scoping phase and follow a rigorous code of conduct on handling sensitive data.
faqs.q7: Can you work in English or internationally?
faqs.a7: Yes. Our consultants work fluently in French and English. We support multi-site organisations and regularly run engagements with an international dimension.
faqs.q8: How do we start a conversation with Kalyce?
faqs.a8: Contact us through the form on this site or by email. We arrange a first 30-minute conversation, with no commitment, to understand your context and propose a suitable approach.

methodPage.sx1: A deep immersion in your organisation to pin down the issues precisely, identify the levers and rule out false trails.
methodPage.sl1a: Mapping of strategic, organisational and human issues
methodPage.sl1c: Executive summary and presentation to the leadership team
methodPage.sx2: Building a clear, prioritised roadmap aligned with your objectives. We give structure to the choices, never make them for you.
methodPage.sl2a: Costed and phased multi-year strategic plan
methodPage.sl2c: Transformation plan with milestones and steering bodies
methodPage.sx3: Operational steering of the workstreams alongside your teams. Our role: move things forward, unblock, arbitrate, hold the course.
methodPage.sl3b: Running the workstreams and cross-functional coordination
methodPage.sx4: Transfer of skills, team training and a follow-up mechanism so the transformation holds over time, without us.
methodPage.px1: No engagement without a clear scope, defined deliverables and shared success criteria. That avoids 80% of the friction.
methodPage.px2: We rely on data, on the ground and on interviews. Our recommendations are evidenced, never ideological.
methodPage.px3: Your teams don't endure the transformation: they carry it. We work with them, not instead of them.
methodPage.px4: Nothing to sell, no commission. Our recommendations serve one interest only: yours.
methodPage.px5: Our contracts set out milestones, deliverables and a mechanism for measuring impact. We commit to the result.
methodPage.px6: A strict code of conduct, a systematic NDA and compartmentalised handling of sensitive information.

refsPage.newD: Kalyce Consulting is a young firm. Rather than display references we do not yet have, here are the sectors we address and the way we work.
refsPage.how1X: A short diagnosis to qualify the need and put a number on what is at stake. It is the way in, and it commits you to little.
refsPage.how2X: The work itself: website, prospecting plan, CRM, automation. Scope and deliverables agreed in advance.
refsPage.how3X: A monthly subscription to maintain what has been put in place — search, CRM, reporting — and adjust as you go.
refsPage.sectD: We do not limit ourselves to one sector. Our approach is cross-cutting and we bring in specialist partners when the issue calls for it.

aboutPage.m1: Kalyce Consulting is an independent management consulting firm, founded on a simple intuition: transformations that last are not decreed, they take root.
aboutPage.m2: We work with executive committees and general management on their most defining subjects: strategic choices, organisational redesign, change management, operational performance. Our involvement aims to be demanding in substance and considerate in form.
aboutPage.m3: We believe in the value of the long view, frank dialogue and shared responsibility. Our engagements are not measured by the weight of the slides delivered, but by the quality of the decisions taken and how concretely they are carried through.
aboutPage.v1x: Every engagement is led by a senior partner, supported by experienced consultants. No pyramid model: substance, time and attention.
aboutPage.v2x: A recommendation is only worth something if it can be applied. We test, adjust and deliver arrangements that work in real life.
aboutPage.v3x: We stay beside our clients all the way to impact. Our fees are transparent and our commitments written down, not implied.
aboutPage.v4x: We sell no product and take no commission. Our only interest is the success of the engagement entrusted to us.
aboutPage.v5x: Our clients entrust us with their most sensitive matters. Discretion is not an option, it is a condition of practice.
aboutPage.v6x: We read, we train, we exchange. The best answers rarely come from a single intellectual framework.
